decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component sprayer extends the firm's core spraying know-how into corrosion protection, its prospects are still uncertain after one year, and keeping it costs little, so the option stays open.
The low-pressure injection pump is close to the established offer for construction repair materials, has its own page signalling commitment, and is cheap to maintain alongside existing production.
The transfer pump uses shared in-house components and adds breadth to the material conveying range at low holding cost, and there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized.

Fire protection flow monitoring fits the firm's digitalization direction and has a dedicated page, so with uncertainty still high and early results too thin to justify abandonment, the option is kept.
